concept_decisions: Retain concept D close-set surface but tighten gaps relative to its hero. Original deterministic jittered planar Voronoi tiling clipped to irregular oval, each cell shrunk only3percent leaving narrow cracks. Cells extruded as low angular faceted clasts with varying thickness0.08to0.18m and shallow irregular crowns. About120clasts, three muted grays merged by material into few meshes. Thin closed ochre substrate visible chiefly sides and cracks, not broad bare sand. No photo textures or pavement origin exclusivity claim.
